description: This file handles generating and sending a Quote PDF via email in the vtiger CRM system. It initializes a PDF controller, loads the relevant record, generates a filename, and outputs the PDF, then navigates back in the browser.

classes.name: Vtiger_QuotePDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating Quote PDFs in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: loadRecord
methods.description: Loads a specific quote record into the PDF generator.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to the specified filepath.
